title: Sleep EEG-fMRI: preprocessing, quality control and sleep staging of EEG recorded inside an MRI scanner
description: Code, quality reports and results for a study of sleep EEG recorded simultaneously with fMRI (OpenNeuro ds003768). Study 01 is an ablation comparing sleep-staging performance on raw, filtered-only and artefact-cleaned EEG, with two heartbeat detectors, using established quality-control methods (PREP, Autoreject, INPS). Data are not included; scripts download them from OpenNeuro.
